title: A tblW-auto column's min-content word breaks after an en dash or em dash like a hyphen; U+2212 MINUS SIGN never breaks
source: probe build.py (A4 9026-twip column, Calibri 11, cell margins 108), Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf lines; the harness measures with the 0.52em heuristic, so the tolerances cover heuristic-vs-Calibri advance drift while keeping the broken and whole cases apart

cases.note: 'mmmm\u2013mmmm' breaks after the en dash: Word wrapped 'mmmm\u2013' | 'mmmm' (= 41.4 pt + margins); the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
'mmmm\u2014mmmm' breaks after the em dash: Word wrapped 'mmmm\u2014' | 'mmmm' (= 46.9 pt + margins)
'mmmm\u2212mmmm' never breaks at the minus sign: Word drew the column 86.6 pt = the whole string + margins
